announcements.headline: Operations Update and Layer 21 Results
announcements.insight: The release of Layer 21 results provides critical visibility into the project's development timeline and capital requirements, which is vital for valuing Ironveld's exploration potential in the current high-cost mining environment.

announcements.headline: TR-1: Notification of major holdings
announcements.insight: This is a standard regulatory disclosure of major shareholdings rather than a transactional event; without accompanying buying/selling data, it offers no immediate signal on insider sentiment or capital flow.
